CarFax No Accidents! Popular Options and Features Include: Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

The 2024 Range Rover Autobiography is the quintessential expression of modern luxury, representing the peak of the Land Rover flagship lineup. This example, with 25,259 miles, features a sophisticated Carpathian Gray Premium Metallic exterior and a rich Deep Garnet leather interior. As an Autobiography trim, it comes nearly fully loaded from the factory, emphasizing a "reductive" design philosophy that hides complex technology behind clean, elegant surfaces while providing an unmatched presence on the road.

Performance
The Autobiography typically features the potent 4.4L Twin-Turbo V8 engine, producing 523 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. This powertrain, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, allows the large SUV to accelerate from 0–60 mph in just 4.4 seconds. Performance is further refined by standard All-Wheel Steering, which grants the vehicle a turning circle similar to a small hatchback, and the Dynamic Response Pro system, which uses electronic active roll control to keep the body flat during cornering.

Design
The exterior is finished in Carpathian Gray, a premium metallic paint that offers a deep, tonal contrast to the Autobiography’s Atlas Silver accents. This model sits on 22-inch Style 1073 Diamond Turned wheels with Gloss Dark Gray contrast. Inside, the Deep Garnet Windsor leather interior provides a bold yet tasteful atmosphere, complemented by SV Bespoke Natural Brown Walnut veneers and an Ebony mohair headliner. The seamless "flush glazing" and deployable door handles contribute to its sleek, aerodynamic profile.

Technology
The cabin is dominated by a 13.1-inch curved-glass Pivi Pro infotainment screen featuring haptic feedback and wireless smartphone integration. The driver interacts with a 12.3-inch Interactive Driver Display and a high-resolution Head-Up Display. For an unparalleled auditory experience, the vehicle is equipped with the Meridian Signature Sound System, which utilizes 34 speakers—including speakers embedded in the headrests—to create individual sound zones and active noise cancellation.

Advanced Safety Features
Standard safety equipment is comprehensive, including a 3D Surround Camera system with "Clear Sight Ground View," which allows the driver to virtually see through the hood. The Autobiography also features Adaptive Cruise Control with Steering Assist, Blind Spot Assist, and a Driver Condition Response system. For night driving, the Pixel LED headlights with Signature DRL utilize 1.2 million micromirrors to cast light precisely around oncoming traffic while maintaining maximum illumination elsewhere.

Convenience and Comfort
The interior is a sanctuary of comfort, featuring 24-way heated, cooled, and "Hot Stone" massage electric front seats. The rear cabin is equally luxurious with Executive Class seating that includes power-deployable center consoles and heated calf rests. Additional high-end conveniences include a front center console refrigerator, soft-close doors, and a powered gesture tailgate.

The 2024 Range Rover Autobiography stands as a pinnacle of modern luxury, blending peerless off-road heritage with sophisticated executive refinement. This particular model, showing 12,698 miles, is enhanced by the Shadow Exterior Pack, which replaces traditional brightwork with a stealthier, more contemporary aesthetic. Equipped with 22-inch wheels and power-deployable running boards, this vehicle offers a commanding presence and effortless entry into one of the most quiet and opulent cabins in the automotive world.

Performance
The 2024 Autobiography is powered by a 4.4L Twin-Turbocharged V8 engine delivering 523 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission and standard All-Wheel Drive, it can propel this large SUV from 0-60 mph in just 4.4 seconds. Performance is further refined by the Electronic Air Suspension with Dynamic Response Pro, which reads the road ahead and primes the suspension for upcoming corners, while all-wheel steering provides the maneuverability of a much smaller vehicle in tight urban spaces.
Design
Visually, the Shadow Exterior Pack lends the vehicle a sophisticated edge, featuring Graphite Atlas accents on the grille, tailgate finishing, and side vents. The 22-inch wheels provide a balanced, planted stance that complements the Range Rover’s iconic "falling" roofline and seamless glass. Inside, the design is a masterclass in minimalism, featuring Semi-Aniline leather upholstery, SV Bespoke Duo Tone leather headlining, and Natural Brown Walnut veneers that create a serene, sanctuary-like environment.
Technology
Central to the dashboard is the 13.1-inch curved Pivi Pro touchscreen, which provides haptic feedback and wireless connectivity for Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The driver is treated to a 13.7-inch Interactive Driver Display and a high-resolution Head-Up Display. Rear passengers are not forgotten, with an 11.4-inch Rear Seat Entertainment system and the Meridian Signature Sound System, which utilizes 35 speakers—including noise-canceling units in the headrests—to create an immersive audio experience.
Advanced Safety Features
Safety is paramount, featuring a comprehensive suite of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). This includes Adaptive Cruise Control with Steering Assist, a 3D Surround Camera for precise low-speed maneuvering, and Blind Spot Assist. The vehicle also employs high-tech solutions like ClearSight Ground View—allowing the driver to effectively "see through" the hood on the display—and the Driver Condition Response system, which can bring the vehicle to a safe stop if it detects the driver is unresponsive.
Convenience and Comfort
Ultimate comfort is delivered via 24-way heated and cooled front seats with "Hot Stone" massage functionality. The four-zone climate control works in tandem with Cabin Air Purification Pro to ensure a pristine environment. Convenience is maximized by the power-deployable running boards for easy ingress, soft-close doors, and a powered gesture tailgate. Additionally, the integrated front center console refrigerator keeps beverages chilled, making long-distance travel an absolute pleasure.
